product.definition: What the product does for its users and the business rules behind it.

scope.definition: What is in or out of the product.
scope.boundary: Cruises are not quoted: scope. How a cruise line would be shown: presentation.

eligibility.definition: Which cases, users or records a rule applies to.
eligibility.boundary: Only hotels get a hotel page: eligibility. What the page shows: presentation.

calculations.definition: How a number the user sees is derived.
calculations.boundary: Line items sum to the total: calculations. Where the total sits: layout.

lifecycle.definition: The states a thing moves through and what moves it.
lifecycle.boundary: A sent quote becomes a read-only version: lifecycle. How versions are stored: persistence.

outcomes.definition: What the product must achieve for its user, as a rule the build follows.
outcomes.boundary: A partner who missed the call can decide from the quote alone: outcomes. The intro wording that serves it: wording.

presentation.definition: What a person sees, reads and does on screen, on paper or in an email.

layout.definition: Where things sit, their order and spacing.
layout.boundary: The price summary follows the itinerary: layout. Its type size: typography.

typography.definition: Typefaces, sizes, weights and text treatment.
typography.boundary: Headings use the serif: typography. What the heading says: wording.

colour.boundary: Optional items use the muted tone: colour. That they are visibly distinct: interaction or layout.

shape-and-depth.definition: Borders, radii, shadows, layering and surfaces.
shape-and-depth.boundary: Cards have no shadow: shape-and-depth. Card order: layout.

media.definition: Images, video, maps and icons: which appear, how they are cropped and framed.
media.boundary: The hero photo is cropped to the subject: media. Which image is chosen for a hotel: sourcing.

wording.definition: Copy, labels, tone and spelling the reader sees.
wording.boundary: Guests see 'travel specialist': wording. That the LLM writes prose only: boundaries.

interaction.definition: What happens when the reader clicks, taps, scrolls or types.
interaction.boundary: A day expands on tap: interaction. How it animates open: motion.

motion.boundary: The route draws as the page scrolls: motion. That a route map exists: media.

information.definition: The data the product holds: its shape, where it comes from and how long it lives.

schemas.definition: The shape of a record: fields, types and nullability.
schemas.boundary: Room carries its capacity columns: schemas. Which source table they come from: sourcing.

sourcing.definition: Where each value comes from and what is never collected.
sourcing.boundary: Facts come from the Publishing Centre payload: sourcing. Reading it through read-only access: permissions.

transformation.definition: How raw values become what is used: selecting, ordering, deriving.
transformation.boundary: Age is computed from date of birth: transformation. Date of birth never reaches output: disclosure.

versioning.definition: How a record or contract changes over time and old versions stay readable.
versioning.boundary: Each sent quote keeps its version number: versioning. Where it is stored: persistence.

persistence.definition: Where and how data is stored.
persistence.boundary: Quotes are written to three document tables: persistence. The rights to write them: permissions.

retention.definition: How long data is kept and when it is removed.
retention.boundary: Every sent version is kept: retention. How it is retrieved: interaction.

execution.definition: How the running system behaves while it works.

coordination.definition: The order steps run in and what triggers them.
coordination.boundary: Generation starts when a quote is published: coordination. Which system owns the trigger: interfaces.

concurrency.definition: What happens when things run at the same time.
concurrency.boundary: Two regenerations of one quote do not overlap: concurrency. Retrying a failed one: retries.

retries.definition: When and how a failed step is tried again.
retries.boundary: An LLM call is retried twice: retries. What the quote shows if it still fails: failure-handling.

timeouts.definition: How long a step may take before it is abandoned.
timeouts.boundary: Generation gives up after a set time: timeouts. What the consultant then sees: failure-handling.

failure-handling.definition: What the system does when data or a step is missing or wrong.
failure-handling.boundary: A missing image falls back to a flagged stock image: failure-handling. Which stock image: media.

resource-use.definition: Limits on cost, memory, row counts and calls.
resource-use.boundary: Development queries are capped in rows: resource-use. The cap's value: configuration.

structure.definition: How the code is divided and what it is built with.

boundaries.definition: What each module owns and must not do.
boundaries.boundary: Prompt construction never makes calls: boundaries. The prompt's wording: wording.

interfaces.definition: Contracts between modules or with other systems.
interfaces.boundary: The payload contract with Publishing Centre: interfaces. The fields in it: schemas.

technology.definition: Languages, libraries, services and platforms chosen.
technology.boundary: The map uses Mapbox GL JS: technology. How the map looks: media.

organisation.definition: File layout, naming and code conventions.
organisation.boundary: One file per group of models: organisation. What the models hold: schemas.

identity.definition: Who a user or service is and how that is proved.
identity.boundary: A public link cannot identify its viewer: identity. That the link is unguessable: cryptography.

permissions.definition: What each identity may read, write or run.
permissions.boundary: Source booking data is read-only: permissions. Which tables are written: persistence.

disclosure.definition: What must never reach a given reader.
disclosure.boundary: Margins never leave Scott Dunn: disclosure. That they are not collected: sourcing.

credentials.definition: How secrets are held, supplied and rotated.
credentials.boundary: Keys live in Key Vault: credentials. Which environment reads them: environments.

cryptography.boundary: Link tokens are random and long: cryptography. Who may open the link: identity.

abuse-prevention.definition: Defences against misuse: enumeration, flooding, injection.
abuse-prevention.boundary: No index of quote links is public: abuse-prevention. The link format: cryptography.

operations.definition: Running the product once it is built.

environments.definition: Which environments exist and what each may touch.
environments.boundary: Legacy procedures run on test only: environments. The identity that runs them: permissions.

deployment.definition: How a build reaches an environment.
deployment.boundary: Everything runs in the client's Azure tenant: deployment. Which Azure services: technology.

configuration.definition: Settings supplied at run time and their defaults.
configuration.boundary: The SQL server name has no default: configuration. Failing loudly when it is missing: failure-handling.

logging.definition: What is written to logs and where.
logging.boundary: Every log line lands in a JSONL file in development: logging. Alerts on it: monitoring.

monitoring.definition: How problems are noticed: alerts, dashboards, health checks.
monitoring.boundary: An alert when generation fails: monitoring. What the quote shows: failure-handling.

recovery.definition: Backups, restores and getting back to a working state.
recovery.boundary: Re-measure access after a test restore: recovery. The access itself: permissions.

delivery.definition: How the work itself is done and handed over.

development-process.definition: How the team plans, branches, reviews and records work.
development-process.boundary: Records live on main only: development-process. The record format: documentation.

testing.boundary: Golden quotes are reproduced exactly: testing. Who signs off: acceptance.

acceptance.definition: Who signs work off and against what.
acceptance.boundary: Consultant UAT tests acceptability, not accuracy: acceptance. The accuracy proof: testing.

documentation.definition: What is written down, where and in what form.
documentation.boundary: Technical docs describe the handover version: documentation. The handover period: handover.

handover.definition: Passing the product to its owner: support, warranty, training.
handover.boundary: Four weeks of post-integration support: handover. What the docs say: documentation.
